detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Spin. Earn. Expand.

Pull the lever and watch your machines come alive. Every spin is a chance to earn, and the more machines you own, the faster your income grows! What starts with a single slot quickly turns into a table full of noise and money.

Upgrade Your Machines

Improve spin speed, increase rewards and push your setup further. Turn a simple machine into a money-printing engine.

Automate

Tired of clicking? Automate the slots and let your machines run on their own!

Progress through the Skill Tree!

Unlock new machines and powerful perks as you progress through the skill tree. Improve your setup, increase efficiency and push your earnings further with every upgrade. And who knows, maybe you'll finally be able to pay off all your debts?
